title: App SEO
description: Manage app profiles and the store signals connected to this site.

views.comingSoon: This workspace is coming soon in this batch.

locked.title: App SEO is available on Pro
locked.description: Upgrade to Pro or higher to register app profiles and open this workspace.

registration.title: Register an app
registration.description: Add a Google Play package, an App Store ID, or both. Registration checks format only and does not use vendor credits.
registration.playHelp: Use the reverse-DNS package ID shown in Google Play.
registration.appleHelp: Enter the 6–12 digit numeric app ID.
registration.pairedLabel: Treat these as the same app
registration.pairedHelp: Pair the two listings only when they represent the same product.

profiles.emptyDescription: Register a Play or App Store listing to begin.
profiles.deleteDescription: Its stored App SEO history will also be removed. This cannot be undone.

states.limitDescription: Delete a profile to free a slot, or choose a plan with more app profiles.

validation.storeRequired: Enter at least one store ID.
validation.playFormat: Enter a reverse-DNS package ID, such as com.example.app.
validation.playTooLong: The Google Play package ID is too long.
validation.appleFormat: Enter a 6–12 digit App Store ID.
validation.pairedRequired: Paired profiles need both store IDs.
